U07-F-36-OFER.original_identifier: §36, printed23; Glossary introduction251; Glossary s.v. ofer297
U07-F-36-OFER.claim: Section36 explicitly names ofer among prepositions taking accusative and dative. Glossary297 marks ofer with an obelus; glossary251 defines that mark as the two-case class, with a general direction/location distinction. This proves both governments without deriving them from case-syncretic eorðan. It is not a claim that every sense permits free case substitution or that all prepositions follow an exceptionless motion/rest rule.
